messages:
sasha: Heads-up: scheduling a 01:30 UTC quick window to flip runtime -> v2.4.1. This is a small patch (kv header normalization) but it's cross-cutting so pin console/router for the 30m window. Release note draft: https://go.redwood/release/runtime-2.4.1

ops-bot: Change window created by sasha for 01:30 UTC (id cw-1766667001). Targets: runtime v2.4.1 canary (10%) -> 50% -> 100%. Pins: console=1.6, router=3.3. Notifying #runtime #console #router.

tom: Why the pin for console? I thought header rename is backwards compatible.

sasha: It's normalization: header key case and whitespace trimmed. Console uses a small client lib that parses exact header names. Risk: older console could show empty KV fields which breaks a few multi-turn flows. Quick pin avoids user-facing UI flakiness.

priya: Ops: can router take the legacy header and map to normalized one? If so we could avoid pin on router.

ryan (ops-bot): Router has a header-compat middleware but it's off by default in prod. We can enable it for the window but prefer pinning to be safer. Enabling middleware adds CPU and needs a rollout test.

priya: Ok let's pin router for the window. Also request a short canary smoke and a synthetic user flow check before moving to 50%.

deploy-bot: Will run the waves and post status. Rollout plan attached to change: canary 10% (10m monitor) -> 50% (15m monitor) -> 100% (10m monitor). If any abort, rollback to v2.4.0.

sasha: Rollback triggers: sustained 5xx > 0.8% for 3m, p95 > 250ms for 10m, or any console critical-flow error >0.5%. Also abort if deploy-bot reports header schema mismatch.

priya: Canary smoke checklist (I put in runbook):
- GET /health -> 200 for runtime
- KV header roundtrip (ensure normalized key seen by router and console)
- end-to-end sample convo for multi-turn path

```bash
# KV roundtrip smoke
curl -s -H "x-rd-kv:   AbC123  " https://staging-runtime.redwood/v1/echo | jq .headers
```

tom: I'll be on-call for console side. I'll watch the UI mapping and post screenshots in-thread if anything odd.

ops-bot: Pinning action scheduled: router>=3.3 pinned at -15m, console=1.6 pinned at -10m. Please confirm owners are ready for immediate abort.

sasha: I'm owner. Priya and Tom ack readiness. I'll kick the canary at 01:30 and stay online.

deploy-bot: Canary started (10%). Monitoring: metrics/latency, metrics/errors, console/critical-flow. Next update in ~8m.

priya: Canary smoke green. Headers normalized as expected, no console errors in synthetic.

ops-bot: Metrics snapshot: 5xx at baseline, p95 latency +10ms (within noise). Proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: Traffic moved to 50%. Monitoring window active.

tom: Seeing two minor console mapping diffs on a legacy flow, but non-blocking. Will watch.

priya: After 10m at 50% all good. Proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: Fully rolled to 100%. Post-roll checks running. Will attach logs.

sasha: Thanks everyone. Leaving pins for 10m post-roll then unpin. If anyone sees anything, call abort now. :eyes:

ops-bot: Pins scheduled for auto-unpin in 10m.

priya: All clear on my end, unpin when ready.

tom: LGTM from console. Unpin allowed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Window cw-1766667001 complete. No rollback. Logs: https://go.redwood/logs/cw-1766667001
